title: Docker Projects
description: Every running docker compose project and its services: status, uptime, CPU, RAM, network, disk, restarts, OOM, logs. New projects appear on their own (from cAdvisor docker labels). Per-container detail (resources, logs) is on the Project and Container dashboards.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: docker compose project name (folder name or -p).

list.name: type
list.label: Type
list.description: container.type label: backend, frontend, db, cache, storage, worker, ...

list.name: lang
list.label: Language
list.description: container.lang label: go, java, node, python, ...

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: Each selected container gets its own row at the bottom of the dashboard.

options.content: Click a project name in **Projects** to filter the whole dashboard. In **Services**: service name = only that service, container name = its logs. Red = needs attention now: OOM, recently restarted, error logs, RAM near limit.

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: Compose projects running now.

panels.title: Containers running
panels.description: Containers running now.

panels.title: Memory: RSS vs cache
panels.description: RSS = real process memory, cache = file cache (reclaimable).

panels.title: Log lines by service
panels.description: Log volume per service.

targets.expr: project:~"${project:regex}" service:~"${service:regex}" type:~"${type:regex}" lang:~"${lang:regex}" team:~"${team:regex}" env:~"${env:regex}" | stats by (service) count()

panels.title: Errors by service
panels.description: Error logs by service.

targets.expr: project:~"${project:regex}" service:~"${service:regex}" type:~"${type:regex}" lang:~"${lang:regex}" team:~"${team:regex}" env:~"${env:regex}" level:(error OR fatal OR panic) | stats by (service) count()

panels.title: Errors & warnings
panels.description: error, fatal, panic, warn lines of the selected projects/services.

targets.expr: project:~"${project:regex}" service:~"${service:regex}" type:~"${type:regex}" lang:~"${lang:regex}" team:~"${team:regex}" env:~"${env:regex}" level:(error OR fatal OR panic OR warn) | sort by (_time desc) | limit 500

panels.title: Top error messages
panels.description: Most repeated errors.

targets.expr: project:~"${project:regex}" service:~"${service:regex}" type:~"${type:regex}" lang:~"${lang:regex}" team:~"${team:regex}" env:~"${env:regex}" level:(error OR fatal OR panic) | unpack_logfmt fields (msg, err, error) keep_original_fields | format if (msg:"") "<_msg>" as msg | stats by (service, msg, err, error) count() hits | sort by (hits desc) | limit 20
